sub_problems.why: Measured 2026-11-23 on akiendelllinux: 60de22e64, a build made on Windows, created cairn/devices/cc/superclaude.py as 100644. The floor (bin/cairn.py _wire_instances) links it as the live superclaude verb, the dispatch refuses a file without the exec bit, and `cairn superclaude` answered 127 for ten hours with nothing red but two proofs in other components. The class: a script born on Windows lands as 100644, because Windows has no exec bit. Ticket 846b6ca0eaf7 fixes the one file and its proof measures only cc (outline 19.6); a check over every device is not inside cc's bounds, so it is this sieve.
